Market today: Mixed signals. Falling Treasury yields could be a tailwind for your tech/chip names, but trade war fears between the US and Canada are creating broader market uncertainty. The data center trade issue isn't about demand, which is a nuanced point for chips.

Your holdings: SOXL (-52.61%) and SPAL (-42.39%) are in deep drawdown, both leveraged ETFs, amplifying losses significantly on margin. SMH (-11.94%) and QQQI (-3.85%) are also flagged for trimming and are near their stops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on Treasury yield movements post-Jackson Hole and any escalation in trade tensions. Also, respect the stops on your leveraged positions.

Bottom line: With significant concentration and margin, aggressive risk management on your leveraged and underperforming positions is paramount.
plays: Consider trimming or exiting SOXL given its "SELL" status and deep -52.61% loss; leveraged decay and margin amplify this risk.
Review SPAL, a new leveraged ETF down -42.39%; its "NEW" status and rapid decay warrant immediate attention to its stop at 21.38.
Respect the stop at 540 for SMH, currently down -11.94% and flagged for "TRIM."
